datum: V. Precious in the sight of the Lord.
R. Is the death of His Saints.
V. O God, come to my assistance.
R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
V. O God, come to my assistance.
R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
V. O God, come to my assistance.
R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
V. Bless ye.
R. May God.
The Lord bless us, and keep us from all evil, and bring us to life everlasting; and may the souls of the Faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.
R. Amen.
Holy Mary and all the Saints plead for us with the Lord, that we may worthily be holpen and saved by Him Who liveth and reigneth for ever and ever.
R. Amen.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
V. Look upon Thy servants, O Lord, and upon Thy works, and guide their children.
R. And the splendour of the Lord our God be upon us, and guide the work of our hands upon us, and the work of our hands so guide.
Let us pray.

Order and hallow, rule and govern, O Lord God, King of heaven and earth, this day our hearts and our bodies, our thoughts, words, and works, according to Thy law and in the doing of Thy commandments, that now, and for ever and ever, we may be worthily saved and freed by Thee, O Saviour of the world,
Who livest and reignest for ever and ever.
R. Amen.
Our days and deeds order the Lord Almighty in His peace.
And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.
O Lord, be gracious unto us: for we have waited for Thee: be Thou our arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
Seek ye the Lord, while He may be found: call ye upon Him while He is near.
I hid not my face from shame and spitting. The Lord God will help me, therefore also shall I not be confounded.
If ye be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth at the right hand of God: set your affections on things above, not on things on the earth.
